comment: What scripts/fetch-accessors.mjs cannot read off a page.
mirror: a directory that receives every accessor and solver the registry
publishes. test/ and sandbox/ read it, and the root page takes its tags there.
extra: directories whose page builds its tags from JavaScript, so that no
element in the HTML states what it needs. Module names as pages spell them.
local: accessors the registry does not publish. They cannot be fetched, so
they stay committed where they are used; the script fails if a demo needs
one that is missing. Each line here is a debt - publishing the accessor
override: files a directory keeps from the repository although the registry
publishes that name, because the published build does not work there. Same
debt as local, one step worse: the registry copy is known to be broken.

pgf.why: bevara:libpgf@1.0.5 as published needs _ZSt7nothrow (std::nothrow), which mm_solver_minimal_1.0.1 does not export: 'UndefinedSymbols: 1 symbol required by libpgf_1.wasm is not exported by this solver'. The pair committed here predates that and decodes. The libpgf in the player tree works with the minimal solver too - publishing it retires this entry.
